pairs.why: B's backdrop is a few large quiet shapes (soft hills, plain sky, thin track strip) with no stray props, like the lessons' preferred wagons, while A adds a mesa, cactus tuft, rock, clouds and a heavy tie-filled track that make the environment busier than the real cards.
Both put the UFO on a flat field of tone-on-tone rings with no props; A's ring bands are slightly more visible, like the real cards' rings, while B's fade out, so the call is close.
